recommendation: Keep the source fix as-is. It reconciles the original STU3 context allowance with later inferSystem terminology without broadening this seed into CQL or future ambiguity-policy questions.
issue_request: FHIR-13326 was a Published/Persuasive STU3 FHIR-core Vocabulary change request for ValueSet $validate-code. It reported that the code input parameter incorrectly required system whenever code was provided, even though context can identify the value set binding for code-typed elements; the resolution agreed and expected an error when context is insufficient to identify an unambiguous concept.
initial_application: The issue was originally applied in git-svn commit 5f4ae7c55f921bd724a82c59f79ee263e4b8445e for svn revision 12752, which changed the old ValueSet spreadsheet sentence from requiring system to allowing system or context and requiring the server to ensure the code is not ambiguous without a system. Later source refactoring preserved that wording in source/valueset/operationdefinition-ValueSet-validate-code.xml.
additional_context: ValueSet remains active in source/fhir.ini and its operations list references OperationDefinition/ValueSet-validate-code. Later Applied issue FHIR-41431 added inferSystem to the same operation and changed the operation description to recommend system or inferSystem when code is supplied. Related ValueSet $validate-code parameter-name issues FHIR-13946 and FHIR-14355 are already represented on the combined branch. Later Zulip terminology discussions support the same ambiguity rule for inferred systems.
reconciliation: Changed only source/valueset/operationdefinition-ValueSet-validate-code.xml at the code input parameter documentation. The new text no longer limits the system-less path to context alone; it says the server may infer the system from the value set context, including the context parameter or inferSystem=true, but SHALL ensure the code is not ambiguous without a system.
source_changes: source/valueset/operationdefinition-ValueSet-validate-code.xml: clarified the code input documentation for ValueSet $validate-code to include context-based and inferSystem-based system inference with the existing ambiguity guard.
